newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver, gold prices hold modest gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver, gold prices hold modest gains.

text.p: Silver prices held modest gains on Friday after stronger start was undermined by fresh arrivals and lower than expected industrial demand, dealers said.
They said about 1,000-1,200 kg of imported silver arrived in the Bombay market and sentiment was subdued at the close of the session.
Gold prices opened higher on the back of recovery in the world market but saw little movement in sluggish activity.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 100 rupees higher at 59,200 per piece, after rising 300 rupees on Thursday.
